description: Declarative local media inventory only. No media is stored in Git; zero hashes and zero duration mark entries awaiting local deposit.
source_policy: Only locally deposited, consented clips may be used. The central runner never downloads media.
backend_policy: YOLOv8n-pose body keypoints through RKNN on RK3588 is optional. No YOLO pose fallback, face backend, or raw Vision forwarding.
